newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: BANGLADESH TAKA LOSES EARLY EDGE AHEAD OF WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: BANGLADESH TAKA LOSES EARLY EDGE AHEAD OF WEEKEND.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka shed early gains against the U.S. dollar in interbank trading on Thursday as state-owned banks stopped trading by midday, dealers said.
The taka ended at Wednesday's closing level at 44.2200/2300 to the dollar, against a quotation of 44.2000/2100 in early trade.
"Selling (of dollars) by state-owned banks remained tight which ultimately helped the U.S. currency," said one dealer.

Call money closed flat at 8.0-8.5 percent. Dealers said banks' payment of over five billion taka against Wednesday's purchase of central bank bills had little impact on liquidity due to the simultaneous maturity of a previous bond worth 3.7 billion taka.
